admin.overviewBody: How the community is doing, without reading anyone's private writing.
admin.privacyNote: Reports show counts only. Reflections, prayer requests, notes and AI conversations are never visible to administrators.
admin.membersBody: Roles, mentors and invitations for your organisation.
admin.editBody: Change roles or assign a mentor. People are told when their roles change.
admin.mentorHelp: A mentor sees this person's shared reflections and can give feedback.
admin.noInvitesBody: Create an invitation and share the code with someone you want to welcome.
admin.inviteBody: Choose the roles this person will have. They can use the code to join.
admin.inviteEmailHelp: Only used to label the invitation. Nothing is sent in this demo.
admin.groupsBody: Small groups that meet and study together.
admin.reportsBody: Participation across the organisation. Counts only, never content.

chart.activitySummary: Activity peaked at {peak} active members in the week of {week}.
chart.noData: There is no activity in this range yet.
chart.pathwaysSummary: {count, plural, one {# pathway} other {# pathways}} with members enrolled.
chart.groupsSummary: Meetings held and average attendance for each group.

admin.settingsBody: How your community looks and how care is shaped.
admin.welcomeHelp: Shown to new members on their first visit.
admin.accentHelp: Used for main actions and highlights across the app.
admin.quietHelp: Mentors see a gentle prompt after this long without contact.
admin.responseHelp: The time mentors aim to reply to a shared reflection.
admin.aiToggleHelp: Lets members ask questions in the AI study companion. Anything shared needs mentor approval.
admin.auditHelp: A record of administrative actions in your organisation.
